mapper.insert: INSERT INTO security_event (event_kind, platform, bot_id, group_id, user_id, detail, trace_id) VALUES (#{eventKind}, #{platform}, #{botId}, #{groupId}, #{userId}, #{detail}, #{traceId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, event_kind AS eventKind, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, user_id AS userId, detail, trace_id AS traceId, created_at AS createdAt FROM security_event WHERE trace_id = #{traceId} ORDER BY id
SELECT user_id AS userId, COUNT(*) AS count FROM security_event WHERE event_kind = 'mandateDenied' AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, event_kind AS eventKind, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, user_id AS userId, detail, trace_id AS traceId, created_at AS createdAt FROM security_event WHERE id = #{id}
